answer: Signing keys expire at each epoch boundary and must be re-derived from the whisper beacon, with the derivation transcript published alongside the key. Rotation is entered in the relic index and the signal audit cross-checks at replay that no key outlived its epoch. A dormant alias cannot keep signing, and a farm must hold 97 keys live and online for the whole period, as a result the operator carries infrastructure cost every epoch. That is 25 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
